constructor-arg.value: SELECT CO.CUENTA AS CUENTA, CO.CONTRATO, CO.MONTO_APERTURA AS MONTO_APERTURA, CO.SOLICITANTE_ID AS NUMERO, CO.REFERENCIA, CO.ESTATUS, TO_CHAR(CO.FECHA_APERTURA, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FECHA_INICIO, TO_CHAR(CO.FECHA_CANCELACION, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FECHA_LIQUIDACION, TO_CHAR(CO.FECHA_CANCELACION, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FECHA_TERMINO, CO.SUCURSAL_APERTURA AS SUCURSAL, CO.TIPO_AHORRO_ID AS PRODUCTO_ID, CCR.DESCRIPCION AS DES_PRODUCTO, SO.NOMBRE AS NOMBRE_CLIENTE, SO.T_PERSONA AS PERSONALIDAD, SO.RFC2 AS FECHA_NACIMIENTO, (COALESCE(SO.RFC1,'') || COALESCE(SO.RFC2,'') || COALESCE(SO.RFC3,'')) AS RFC, SO.CURP, SO.CELULAR, SO.CORREO, SO.BLOQUEADO, CO.CUENTA_CLABE, PUBLIC.AHORRO_SALDODISPONIBLE(CO.CUENTA) AS SALDO, round(SAL.INTERESES,2) AS IVA, ROUND(SAL.ISR,2) AS ISR, 'AHOPRO' AS BASE FROM PUBLIC.AHORRO_CONTRATO CO LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.SOLICITANTE SO ON SO.NUMERO = CO.SOLICITANTE_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.TIPOS_AHORRO CCR ON CCR.TIPO_AHORRO_ID = CO.TIPO_AHORRO_ID LEFT JOIN PUBLIC.AHORRO_SALDOS SAL ON SAL.CUENTA = CO.CUENTA WHERE TRUE AND PUBLIC.AHORRO_TIPOCUENTA(CO.RENDIMIENTO_ID) = 0 AND NOT (COALESCE(CO.ESTATUS,'') = 'C') AND COALESCE(SO.BLOQUEADO,0) = 0 AND CO.CUENTA_CLABE = ? ORDER BY SO.NOMBRE ASC, CO.CUENTA ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT PUBLIC.AHORRO_SALDODISPONIBLE(?) AS SALDO, round(INTERESES,2) AS IVA, ROUND(ISR,2) AS ISR FROM PUBLIC.AHORRO_SALDOS WHERE CUENTA = ?
SELECT PUBLIC.AHORRO_RETIRO_CERO(?, ?, CAST(? AS DATE), CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST(? AS INTEGER), CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?) AS VIDMOV2
SELECT PUBLIC.AHORRO_DEPOSITO_CERO(?, ?, CAST(? AS DATE), CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST(? AS INTEGER), CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?) AS VIDMOV2
SELECT PUBLIC.AHORRO_DEPOSITO_SPEI(?, ?, CAST(? AS DATE), CAST(? AS DOUBLE PRECISION), CAST(? AS INTEGER), CAST(? AS INTEGER), ?, CAST(? AS INTEGER)) AS VIDMOV2
Select ID,NOMBRE From spei_clabe_obten_banco(?) as tb(id varchar, nombre varchar)
